warning.description: A rule violation on one cell. Nothing is refused: the cell carries the warning and the Warnings filter lists it.

culture.description: A culture name (`de`, `de-DE`, `sr-Latn-RS`), or the empty string for the neutral file.

rule.description: The rule (proposal 0005 section 2, the settings `resx.rules.*`): `placeholders` (the translation's format placeholders `{0}`, `{name}`, `%s` differ from the neutral value's), `punctuation` (the leading or trailing punctuation differs), `whitespace` (the leading or trailing white space differs), `untranslated` (the translation equals the neutral value).

message.description: The rule's message, as the cell's tooltip shows it.

cultures.description: The cultures answered, the neutral file first.

items.description: A culture name (`de`, `de-DE`, `sr-Latn-RS`), or the empty string for the neutral file.

total.description: Entries matching the filters, before paging.

entries.description: The page, in file order of the neutral file (a key only a culture file has comes after, by key).

invariant.description: The key is marked invariant (`{Invariant}` in the neutral comment): never translated, excluded from the missing counts.

cells.description: One cell per requested culture, the neutral file first (its `culture` is the empty string).

items.description: One culture's value and comment for a key.

culture.description: A culture name (`de`, `de-DE`, `sr-Latn-RS`), or the empty string for the neutral file.

value.description: The value; absent when the culture file has no entry for the key (a missing cell).

comment.description: The comment; absent when the entry has none. The neutral entry's comment carries `{Invariant}` for an invariant key.

missing.description: True when the culture file has no entry for this key.

warnings.description: The rule warnings on this cell.

line.description: The entry's 1-based line in its file, for Open With > XML (Text) Editor.

references.description: Uses of the key in code, once eludite.resx.references has scanned (a later brief); absent before.

changed.description: A cell of the key differs from `HEAD` or the snapshot (eludite.resx.changes, a later brief); absent before.
